metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious Entra ID Token Request for Device Registration Service
properties.description:
Detects a non-interactive sign-in using a refresh token for the Microsoft Authentication Broker client, targeting the Device Registration Service (DRS) with the 'adrs_access' scope.
This specific combination of attributes is highly indicative of an adversary using tools like ROADtools to register a malicious device in the tenant following a successful OAuth phishing attack.
properties.query:
//Detects a non-interactive sign-in using a refresh token for the Microsoft Authentication Broker client, targeting the Device Registration Service (DRS) with the 'adrs_access' scope. This specific combination of attributes is highly indicative of an adversary using tools like ROADtools to register a malicious device in the tenant following a successful OAuth phishing attack.
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppId == "29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e"
| where ResourceIdentity == "01cb2876-7ebd-4aa4-9cc9-d28bd4d359a9"
| where UserType contains "Guest"
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails contains "adrs_access"
| extend
  Account = tostring(column_ifexists("UserPrincipalName", "")),
  SourceIP = tostring(column_ifexists("IPAddress", ""))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Account,
    SourceIP,
    AppDisplayName,
    ResourceDisplayName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
